xuzhou-2018.notes: QOJ dashboard; the 13 problems A-M agree with the catalogue. Its 'Statements (en)' attachment is not in our copy and may be worth capturing. The pack's location field reads 'xxxx', which looks like a placeholder; the dashboard gives no place or date.

sources.evidence: QOJ dashboard headed "The 2018 ICPC Asia Xuzhou Regional Programming Contest" listing 13 problems A to M, Rikka with Minimum Spanning Trees to Rikka with Illuminations.

xuzhou-2019.notes: Luogu pages P17731-P17743 match problems A-M by name in order (no letters printed). On P17733 (<3 numbers), P17734 (Polycut) and P17735 (Multiply) the visible statement is cut at the first '<' character; the full text is only in the page's embedded script data. No source states a contest date.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a QOJ login page; our copy has since been replaced and now holds the contest's dashboard with its problem list.
